breakdown.description: The prompt describes a turbulent flow but sets the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero. This is physically incorrect and will prevent turbulence from developing correctly from the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that setting the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero was physically incorrect for a turbulent flow simulation. It proceeded to calculate appropriate non-zero values for both k (0.75) and omega (148.4) and explicitly instructed to correct the inlet boundary conditions to use these new, physically realistic values. This directly resolves the inconsistency.
